card: Extends P2P fuzz targets to process BIP 157 block filter messages. Currently, filter-related P2P message handling has no fuzz test coverage, leaving parsing and logic bugs in net_processing undiscovered by automated fuzzing. The author demonstrates that enabling this coverage immediately triggers an integer overflow UBSan violation in net_processing.cpp referencing #36321.
evidence: PR description: 'The BIP157 P2P messages are not covered by any fuzz targets at all.'
PR description demonstrates that adding coverage triggers an existing unsigned integer overflow under UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer in net_processing.cpp:3662 referencing #36321.
problem: BIP 157 block filter P2P messages are entirely unexercised by existing fuzz targets. Message handling regressions and sanitizer-detectable bugs in those paths cannot be caught through automated fuzzing.

risk.why: Touches only fuzz testing harnesses; mistakes cannot affect production node behavior.

summary: Expands P2P fuzz testing targets to process BIP 157 compact block filter network messages. This exercises message handling paths for filter-related P2P interactions that were previously untouched by the fuzz engine.
